name: Aggressive Assault
description: Attacks the enemy with the highest Attack Bar 3 times, dealing damage that ignores Defense based on the difference in Attack Speed between the boss and the target, and decreasing its Attack Bar by 30% on each hit.

name: Magic Fog (Passive)

name: Sensory Disruption (Passive)
description: Attacks taken from enemies with lower Attack Speed than the boss always land as a Glancing Hit. [Automatic Effect]

name: Quadruple Slash
description: Attacks all enemies 4 times. The first hit removes 1 beneficial effect with a 75% chance, the second hit decreases their Defense for 2 turns with a 75% chance, the third hit grants Seal for 2 turns with a 75% chance, and the fourth hit disturbs HP recovery for 2 turns with a 75% chance.

name: Swordplay Onslaught
description: Attacks the enemy 7 times. First to sixth hits remove 1 beneficial effect with a 20% chance and stun for 1 turn with a 20% chance. The last hit deals damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken.

name: Final Counter
description: Attacks the enemy to instantly defeat the target. This skill can be used when the boss has no weapons.
